ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Waveedit.DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "waveedit.dll", which is part of the Nero WaveEditor audio editing software. Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\waveedit\\\.dll$") AND  NOT (((process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Nero\\Nero\ Apps\\Nero\ WaveEditor\\waveedit\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Nero\\Nero\ Apps\\Nero\ WaveEditor\\waveedit\.exe") AND (ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Nero\\\\Nero\\ Apps\\\\Nero\\ WaveEditor\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Nero\\\\Nero\\ Apps\\\\Nero\\ WaveEditor\\\\"))))
